description: Two side-by-side photographs illustrating the land cover class "Glaciers and perpetual snow." The left photograph depicts a glacier flowing down a mountain valley, with prominent snow-covered peaks, dark rocky slopes, and areas of green vegetation at lower elevations, all under a partly cloudy blue sky. This image is from Kebnekaise, Sweden, with a capture date of 2010-09-07. Its caption indicates it is derived from Spot 5 satellite data (2.5 m resolution; 3/4/2 band combination) by CNES 2011©, Distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image, and references a yellow delineation from CORINE Land Cover (CLC) that corresponds to a Protected Area (PA) delineation (though the delineation is not clearly visible in this image). The right photograph shows heavily snow-covered mountain ridges and peaks under a clear blue sky, also representing glaciers and perpetual snow. This image is also located in Kebnekaise, Sweden, and is credited to Lantmäteriet, Sweden, referring to topographical map content.
